title: Analysis of Log-Weighted Quadrature Domains
summary: This paper studies plane domains satisfying a quadrature identity with respect to the singular weight $ρ_0(w)=|w|^{-2}$. These are referred to as log-weighted quadrature domains (LQDs). The logarithmic singularity at $w=0$ leads to phenomena not present in the classical theory: in particular, when the domain contains the origin, the associated quadrature data are no longer unique, but are determined only up to a point charge at $0$.
